listSource: Official PS5 trophy list as published by PlayStation and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles (55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned).

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
PlayStation Blog — Grand Theft Auto VI launch coverage

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: work the roadmap stages in order, keep an eye on the five missable flags, and this one closes the list. Roadmap reporting puts a full completion in the region of 200 hours, most of it in the stage-4 grinds rather than the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It is unmissable and doubles as the game's tutorial: follow the on-screen prompts, learn the movement, driving and cover basics, and the trophy pops at the mission's end. If you are new to the series, take the opening slowly — several later trophies assume these basics.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 1. Story chapters cannot be missed: just keep following the campaign markers. Use this chapter to start good habits — loot bodies, keep both protagonists' garages in mind for later property trophies, and try each new activity once as it unlocks, which feeds Master of None later.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The name is censored on PlayStation itself; the requirement is simply to play the campaign through its second chapter. By now the map and the stranger strands are opening up — it is safe to detour, because nothing in the chapter structure locks you out of side content afterwards.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3, the midpoint of the campaign. Keep pushing the story before heavy grinding: several activities, properties and robbery targets only unlock as the chapters advance, so a story-first route makes the later cleanup stages shorter.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Before you start the final mission, sweep up the one-off moments flagged missable in this guide — the official descriptions give no promise of a chapter replay, so treat story-context actions as one-chance until you hold them.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — the campaign's gold. Stock up on armour, snacks and ammo for both protagonists before the point-of-no-return prompt, and make a manual save in a separate slot first: choice-flavoured hidden trophies sit around the endgame, and a spare save is cheap insurance. Finishing the story also frees the whole map for the cleanup stages.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. Named-mission trophies like this one are unmissable if you play the campaign in order; the trophy lands on the mission-complete screen, not during the action, so do not worry if it does not pop mid-mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's set-piece scores. Heist-style missions reward a prepared crew and a clean exit vehicle; if a loud approach keeps failing, the quieter entry the mission offers is usually the safer route. The trophy is for completion, not for a gold medal, so any approach counts.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission bronzes it cannot be missed on a normal campaign run — finish the mission and it is yours. If you are hunting medals as well, replays are a separate concern; this trophy only asks for one completion.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the campaign in order and this unlocks on the completion screen. Missions with a public-facing set piece tend to spike your wanted level — have an exit route or a cheap car you do not mind losing.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport-authority mission. While you are in and around VCIA for this mission, keep Catch Me If You Can in mind: its 'unscheduled departure' is tied to this location and is far easier to arrange during the mission window than afterwards, so this guide flags it as missable.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late-campaign operation. It is one of the heavier combat missions: go in with full armour and your best weapons for both protagonists, and use Combat Focus early rather than saving it — the same habit earns Gunslinger when five enemies fall inside one use.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion counter. Roadmap reporting describes the checklist as lenient: the game asks for a generous subset of its content — the story, the stranger strands, a spread of activities, collectibles and hobbies — rather than literally everything in Leonida. Track the percentage in the pause menu as you clear stages 2 to 4 of this roadmap, and mop up whichever category the counter still wants at the end.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps and stunt events across Leonida — one of the two big silver grinds. Do not leave it all for the end: tag stunt ramps as you explore, clear a handful per session, and use a fast, durable car or bike you can replace cheaply, because failed landings still cost you the vehicle. The in-game stats page tracks the running count.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once: races, drone races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, meditation spots and the rest of the map's pastimes. You only need to start each type, not win it. Work down the map legend activity by activity; this also scouts the locations that half a dozen later trophies depend on.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 challenges across the range's weapon classes. Learn one weapon class at a time, prioritise accuracy chains over raw speed until the medal thresholds make sense, and replay freely: medals are kept per challenge, so progress is never lost. Along with Cunning Stunts this is the grind that decides most platinum times.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one. A win at each course is required, not a medal sweep: learn each route with a practice run, then race it clean — clipping a gate costs more time than a slightly wider line. Courses unlock as the map opens, so finish the story first if a location seems missing.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Bring a tuned car in the right class, learn the first two corners of each course, and count your wins in the stats page. Race wins also pay, which quietly feeds the money trophies (Treat Yo Self and Dime on the Dollar) while you grind.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the game's fishing rival, in one of his fishing challenges. Use the best rod and bait you have unlocked, fish at the spot and time of day the challenge sets, and play the catch carefully — a snapped line restarts the attempt, not the trophy. If Cal keeps winning, upgrade your tackle through the fishing shops and come back; the challenge stays available.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game at an arcade or bar cabinet. 'Complete' means finishing the cabinet's game — reach its end or clear its final level — rather than just playing a credit. Pick the shortest cabinet you find early on and bank this in minutes; it also ticks one activity type toward Master of None.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand: work through each of Andy's missions as they appear until the strand's final mission, and complete it. Strands unlock in stages as the story advances, so if Andy goes quiet, progress the campaign and check the map again. Every finished strand also counts toward the Strangers & Freaks silver, which needs eight.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand by completing its final mission. The title hints the strand involves the water — go in with a boat you can afford to lose and a wanted-level escape plan. Strand missions chain over in-game days; if the next step has not appeared, sleep or advance time and re-check Kenton's marker.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, ending with its final mission. Keep a fast bike or car garaged for this strand — its missions are vehicle-flavoured — and complete each step as it unlocks so the finale appears before the endgame. Counts toward the eight strands the Strangers & Freaks silver requires.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Five strands end in their own bronze trophies — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — so finishing those five leaves three more strands to find among the question-mark markers on the map. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, not when it is started; clear strands as they unlock instead of stockpiling them for the endgame.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand through its final mission. The strand's supply-run flavour means delivery driving under pressure: use a sturdy vehicle, plot the route before the timer starts, and do not stop to fight unless the mission forces it. One of the five named strands feeding the Strangers & Freaks silver.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand by completing its final mission. As with the other named strands, the finale only appears after the earlier steps are done and the story has advanced far enough — if Tyrone's marker vanishes, progress the campaign and return. Completing it also banks one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and use every meditation spot in Leonida. The spots sit in scenic, quiet places — rooftops, beaches, hilltops, the Keys — and each visit is quick: interact, let the animation finish, move on. Sweep region by region while you explore for The Goodtime State, and mark visited spots on the map so the last few are easy to isolate.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Unique animals spawn in a set hunting ground rather than anywhere on the map: work the area methodically, use the best rifle you own, and aim for a clean kill so the pelt and the trophy both count. This is part of Bret's stranger content, so start it from his marker when it appears.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three full sets of the collectible cards scattered around Leonida. Cards are a classic sweep collectible: pick up every card you pass from the first hour, because backtracking for a nearly-finished set is the slow way to do this. The pause-menu collection page shows which sets are closest — finish the three nearest sets rather than spreading pickups evenly across all of them.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo spots at 100 different locations. Each spot asks for a snap of a landmark or view; the interaction is quick, so the real work is travelling. Chain spots into your exploration routes region by region — the same sweep that uncovers the map for The Goodtime State — and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind until the last dozen or so.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges — the bite-size objectives tracked in the challenges menu (driving, combat, exploration and activity feats). Most complete themselves as you play the roadmap; check the menu at stage 4 and deliberately mop up the cheapest remaining ones — short, repeatable challenges — instead of starting new long ones.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While your partner is with you, earn a four-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape. The reliable way: cause trouble together somewhere with a fast escape route — a boat at the marina or a car near a tunnel or alley network — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain. Do it during free-roam time together rather than inside a mission, so a failure costs nothing.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in one continuous wanted run: the wanted level must never fully clear between shops. Pick a tight cluster of three shops, park the getaway car facing the exit before the first robbery, keep each till stop fast, and drive straight to the next shop while the heat is still on. If the stars start blinking down between shops, a quick crime in view of a witness re-pins them.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — entering a vehicle model for the first time registers it. Play normally and this climbs on its own; speed it up by sweeping parking lots, marinas, airfields and rich districts, hopping into every unfamiliar model you pass, including boats and aircraft. The stats page tracks the discovered count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the protagonists' slow-motion aiming ability. Set it up rather than hoping for it: pick a gang spot or an illegal operation with at least five enemies in the open, line up your targets before triggering, and use a high-capacity automatic weapon. Pest Control targets and heist escapes are natural places to try.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: an 'unscheduled departure' at VCIA — the airport — reads as stealing an aircraft and taking off outside any mission script, and the natural window is the VCIA Takedown mission (Hi-Jacked), when you are already inside the airport with its aircraft around you. During that mission, break away, board a plane or helicopter and get airborne. If you finish the campaign without it, try the airport in free roam — but do not rely on that; treat the mission window as the chance.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The jokey description hides a simple ask: get into a Rhino tank. Rhinos appear once your wanted level draws a military response and around military sites late in the game. Raise five stars near an open area, let a Rhino arrive, clear its escort, and climb in before it is destroyed — entering it is what counts, so bail out straight after if you like.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected: no alarm raised, no wanted level from witnesses. Go at night, use a suppressed approach or melee takedowns on staff before they can react, wear a mask, and park the getaway out of sight of the door. If a detection meter starts to fill, stop and let it settle rather than rushing the till.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape the police each time — a robbery only counts once you have lost the heat. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery set: scout the bank, bring cutting or drilling gear as the job demands, and plan the exit before you start, because the response is fast and armoured. Space the five across stage 4; the take also funds Little Boxes and Treat Yo Self.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armoured truck and escape. Trucks run fixed routes; ambush one where you control the ground — block it with a heavy vehicle, deal with the guards, breach the rear doors with explosives or the prompted method, grab the cash and leave in a pre-parked car that is not the one you blocked with. One clean job is all it takes.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map of Leonida — every district, island and stretch of water the fog covers. Combine it with the stage-3 collectible sweeps (meditation spots, WAiNK photo spots, card pickups) so no trip is wasted, and finish the stubborn corners — the far Keys, the swamp interior, offshore islands — by boat and plane at the end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each of Leonida's gangs — every gang needs a tick, so repeating one gang's sites does not finish it. Operations are guarded; scout the entrances, thin the guards quietly where you can, grab the stash and leave before reinforcements stack up. These sites are also good places to attempt Gunslinger's five-in-one-Focus.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: the title and wording point at an early-game moment — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, the game's postcard strip. Early in the campaign, when you are on Ocean Beach with your partner, visit the beachfront bars and take the drink interaction when it is offered rather than rushing the objective. One-off scene trophies like this are the classic missable shape, and the official description gives no second location, so treat the first visit as the chance.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: smashing out of a vehicle showroom 'in classic style' — driving a car through the showroom glass — is the sort of thing a specific story beat sets up and free roam may not reproduce on demand. When a mission or strand puts you inside a vehicle showroom with a car, take the glass exit instead of the door. If you are past that beat, try the same move at a showroom in free roam, but treat the scripted moment as the reliable chance.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: a 'follow-through' at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — completing the bowling beat the story sets at that alley, most plausibly finishing the game or scene there when a mission or date takes you. When the campaign brings you to the alley, play it through instead of leaving early. The alley also matters for Ten Pin, which is a separate, repeatable drive-by trick in the same place.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden partner trophy with a deliberately vague official line — 'a partnership with mass appeal'. Read plainly, it belongs to the two-protagonist partnership system: spend time with your partner, take their hangouts and joint activities when offered, and keep both protagonists progressing together rather than soloing everything on one. It is flagged hidden, so do not expect the game to signpost it; if it has not popped by the endgame, work the partner activities list with both characters.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: the official line — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — says this one hangs on a decision the story offers, and a choice, once made, is the definition of missable on a single save. Keep a manual save in a spare slot before major story decisions from mid-campaign on, so a locked-out outcome is a reload away rather than a new playthrough. If you reach the credits without it, that spare save is your route back.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description gives the method away: something must go wrong once and right the second time — a fail-then-succeed event. When a repeatable activity, job or encounter can fail, do not reload an old save to erase the failure: let it stand, run the same thing again, and succeed. The trophy rewards the retry, so the only way to miss time on it is to never fail at anything — an unlikely problem.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden oddity trophy — the description is a reaction, not an instruction, which in this series means a scripted strange event: something unexplained in the swamps, the sky or the water at odd hours. Explore Leonida's remote corners at night during stage 3 and 4 sweeps, investigate anything that looks staged rather than random, and stay for the whole event when it starts. It is an encounter, not a grind: once seen through, it pops.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people down with a melee drive-by — swinging a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — in the spirit of the bowling alley it shares its name with. Ride a motorcycle or open vehicle past a group of pedestrians or enemies with a melee weapon equipped and swing as you pass; a cluster outside the Kolt & Associates alley is the thematic place to do it. One solid connection run is the whole job.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your laundering contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — shops, trucks, vaults — so this builds naturally while you clear the robbery trophies; the discipline is to always run the bills through your contacts instead of sitting on them. The stats page tracks laundered earnings if you want to pace it.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles services, food, tattoos, everything counts as long as it is shop spending. You will pass this without trying if you gear up properly for the heists and the endgame; if it lags, high-end vehicles services and weapon upgrades burn money fastest. Both protagonists' spending adds to the same total.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garages come up for sale as the story opens the map; buy them as your robbery income allows rather than saving for a single spree, because owned garages also make the vehicle trophies easier. The property list in the pause menu shows what is still missing — the last garage is usually the expensive one, funded by the vault robberies.
sources: PowerPyx — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide and platinum roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game vehicle registry. Any vehicle you own or take can be registered through the app or at a garage: steal or buy ten different rides over the course of the roadmap and register each one as you go. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good's 100 discovered vehicles; register your favourites before you dump them.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list and guide
